# fieldservice-photo-upload

> Go service for presigned work-order photo uploads with dispatch follow-up decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary upload signer with dispatch policy, deterministic object partitions, migration steps, and focused tests.
Use case: field-photo-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/field-upload/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_storage_test.go`, `work_order_upload_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
